changeSet.author: welcome-home
changeSet.comment: Nuki's Web API may report a lock offline while the lock is online and opens. offline_since is when the app first saw Nuki report the lock offline, NULL while Nuki reports it online; offline_disproved_at is when a guest's opening succeeded since then, NULL again once an opening fails. A lock reported offline and disproved is not told to its owner as a problem.
